Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.smoother

Class OscillatingFloatSmoother

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.smoother.OscillatingFloatSmoother
All Implemented Interfaces:
FloatTransitionSmoother, TransitionSmoother
public class OscillatingFloatSmoother extends Object implements FloatTransitionSmoother
A smoother that doesn't reaches the target value, but generates alternating sequence of float value around the specified base value.
